synthesis:draft.headline: Victoria RRP reached 406.00544 $/MWh at 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST; the Hazelwood 220 kV bus-tie outage in the AEMO notice is timed at 2026-08-20 11:00 AEST, after the price extreme.
summary: The 5-minute Regional Reference Price (RRP) peak in VIC1 during the window was 406.00544 $/MWh at interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z (2026-08-20 09:10 AEST) [ev0436].

Six 5-minute intervals in the window met the project analysis threshold of 300 $/MWh (threshold and count: ev0976, ev0975); the first interval at-or-above that threshold began at interval ending 2026-08-19T23:05:00Z with RRP 349.9 $/MWh [ev0433].

Dispatch TOTALDEMAND at the 5-minute peak interval (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z) was 6639.92 MW [ev0437]; net interchange at that interval was −718.24 MW (net flow into VIC1 / import) [ev0438].

Operational demand (average 30-minute) in the half-hour containing the price extreme (half-hour ending 2026-08-19T23:30:00Z) was 6812.0 MW [ev0912]; the window's maximum operational demand observed in the returned series was 7485.0 MW at interval ending 2026-08-20T08:30:00Z [ev0930].

The AEMO market notice about the Hazelwood bus‑tie outage gives 2026-08-20 11:00 AEST (2026-08-20T01:00:00Z) and states the outage at that time; this is after the price extreme (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:10 AEST) and after the last 5-minute interval at-or-above the analysis threshold (interval ending 2026-08-19T23:45:00Z = 2026-08-20 09:45 AEST).

possible_explanations.statement: The price spike may be associated with short‑term interconnector flow changes or a binding constraint around the 5-minute intervals 2026-08-19T23:05:00Z–2026-08-19T23:15:00Z (see the observed net interchange −718.24 MW [ev0438] and the price rise from the interval ending 2026-08-19T23:05:00Z) .
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Check AEMO constraint binding logs and Dispatch Constraint Set (DCS) activation timestamps for 2026-08-19T23:05:00Z–2026-08-19T23:15:00Z to see which constraints, if any, bound during those intervals.

possible_explanations.statement: The price spike may be linked to rapid generator output changes or unit trips in the 5-minute window ending 2026-08-19T23:10:00Z.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Examine unit‑level 5‑minute SCADA and dispatch traces (DUID output) and the NEMDE offer/bid stacks for the intervals 2026-08-19T23:00:00Z–2026-08-19T23:15:00Z to identify sudden output reductions or trips.

possible_explanations.statement: The price spike may be related to a demand or forecast surprise tightening supply around the event intervals.
possible_explanations.what_would_test_it: Compare relevant AEMO forecast runs against actual operational demand and dispatch TOTALDEMAND for the same interval set (for example the intervals reported around 2026-08-19T23:00:00Z–2026-08-19T23:30:00Z) to measure forecast error and its timing.
